_comment: Seed snapshot of Azure built-in policy metadata consumed by bulk_enrich.py. Keyed by policy definition GUID (the 'name' field). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for policy-field content - do not hand-edit rule fields in output YAML; grow this snapshot via 'bulk_enrich.py --refresh <GUID,...>' which fetches each definition from the Azure/azure-policy repo (or 'az policy definition show' with --use-az) and merges derived fields here. This seed intentionally holds only a few well-known policies; bulk_enrich also derives 'service' from the ARM resource type and supplies generic severity/remediation when a GUID is absent, so an empty/partial snapshot still produces a READY file for common policies.
